caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 1162 of 2006
lawyer:
Subhas Chandra Saha, Advocate, instructed by Mr. Chowdhury Md. Zahangir, Advocate-on-Record   ------ For the Petitioner 
Nurul Islam Bhuiyan, Advocate-on-Record. ------ For the Respondents
parties:
Nurun Nabi Mondal   ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Momtazuddin Mondal being deceased his heirs 1(a) Md. Sharafat Hossain and others  ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 2. Facts in brief, arc that Momtajuddin Mondal, the predecessor of the respondent No.1(a) to 1(f) and Fayenuddin Mondal the predecessor of the respondent Nos. 2 (a) to 2(j) filed the above Other Class Suit No.83 of 1987 on the averments that the suit land belonged to the Ganendra Chandra Basak Mallick and 4 others, the Zamindaris, on the basis of Amalnama executed by the Naib on behalf of the Zaminders the suit land leased out the same to Ishratullah, the predecessor of the plaintiff on 1st Falgun 1333 B.S. at an annual rent of Tk.7 and 14 annas as acceptance of Nazrana and Ishratullah paid rent to the Zamindars and got dakhilas; Ishratulla died leaving the plaintiffs as heirs and the defendants and their predecessors never took lease of the suit land from the Zaminders and they also got no title and possession on the suit land; Kismatullah, the predecessor of defendant No.1 and defendant Nos. 2-6 was clever and educated whereas Ishratullah, the predecessor of the plaintiff, was illiterate and foolish and Kismotullah, in order to grab the suit land illegally in collusion with the Survey Officials got his name recorded in Khatian No.124, (Hal Khatian) along with the name of the plaintiff in respect of the suit land and the above wrong entry in Hal Khatian No.224 IN in the name of the defendant No.1 and the predecessor of the defendant Nos.2-6 has caste cloud upon the title of the plaintiff in the suit land and hence the suit. The defendant No.1-6 contested the above suit and filed written statement contending that the suit land originally belonged to the name of the Zamindars and thereafter Ishratullah, the predecessor of the petitioners, and Kismatulla, (the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 2-6 and Majaruddin, the defendant No.1) and while they were in joint mess took lease of the suit land from the aforesaid Zamindars in the year 1321 (135113.S.) on payment of proper najrana out of the joint fund of the joint family and had been possessing the suit land jointly; during revisional survey the suit land was recorded correctly in the names of Eshradullah Majoruddin and Kishmatullah in the S.A. Khatian No.124 (Hal Khatian and the plaintiffs were aware of the same; thereafter aforesaid Eshratulla died leaving two sons Mamtajuddin and Fayenduddin, the plain go tiff Nos. 1 and 2, and thereafter Kismatullah died leaving 5 sons defendant Nos. 2-6 namely (1) Yakub Ali, (2) Ismail Hossain, (3) Ishaq, (4) Nurul Islam and (5) Nurun Nabi as heirs; thereafter the plaintiff No.1 sold .11½ acre of land out of the suit land along with other lands to the defendant Nos. 3 and 4 by a registered kabala dated 10.7.1978 and gave possession of the same in their favour; thereafter the plaintiff No.1 also sold .06 acre of land out of the suit land to the defendant No.5 by a registered kabala dated 10.7.1978 and gave possession of the same in his favour; thereafter the plaintiff No.1 sold .41 acre of land out of the suit land to the defendants Nos. 3, 4 and 5 by a registered kabala dated 27.12.1987 and gave possession of the same in their favour and accordingly plaintiff No.1 exhausted his share in the suit land; the defendant Nos.2-6 got a kharaji khatian in their names in respect of their paternal property as well as their purchased land to the knowledge of the plaintiffs; the suit property is tank; the plaintiff No.1 has got no possession and title in the suit tank; the defendants are in ejmali possession of the suit property with the plaintiff No.2; that the defendants and plaintiff No.2 are possessing the suit tank jointly by rearing fish therein. The learned Senior Assistant Judge.
